items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022
items.q: Apparently in 1967 Art Blakey hired Slide Hampton for the Messengers and to be the musical director.

ctx.x: a year. That’s all I want you to do, this group is so important I’m going to finance the whole thing for a solid year.” Do you think you would have trouble doing that and giving up all the other things that you do?

Well I mean as I kind of said, the question has a different meaning now, interestingly. (a) like I said, the pandemic has kind of eliminated everything else. I mean I’ve been doing some things at home, I’ve known about some of this music before but I’ve discovered some things. There’s an interesting period, I mean this is like the historical part of me which is fun, and this is the kind of thing where if things were normal I’d be like okay let me get this somewhere and try it. But apparently, I mean I sort of…
Yeah. When I get asked to define hard bop it’s hard. So do you have a definition of hard bop that I could borrow from you and I’ll give you credit?
